name: Kimodo moves
summary: Text to human motion with NVIDIA Kimodo: type what the body does, get an animated SOMA skeleton (GLB) and Kimodo's own motion file (NPZ).

needs.gpu: NVIDIA, 17 GB video memory; about 3 GB with 'Text encoder on CPU' (then about 20 GB of system memory)
needs.python: >=3.10 with venv, plus g++ (Kimodo builds a small C++ part)
needs.weights: run get_weights.sh once after install; it needs a Hugging Face token with access to meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct

models.name: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
models.licence: Meta Llama 3 Community License (gated: you accept it on Hugging Face)

tools.label: Make a move
tools.hint: Describe one move in English (e.g. 'A soldier thrusts a spear forward, then steps back'); Kimodo animates a human skeleton.

inputs.label: Text encoder on CPU (little video memory)
